description:
Scope-expansion subticket carved by the orchestrator from beadwork-vd6.1 verification (VERIFY: FAIL, 2026-07-11).

Rationale: TestSignalConcurrentEmits (internal/issue) loses a record ~10% of runs ("records = 1, want 2"). Root cause confirmed at internal/treefs/treefs.go:461 — casUpdateRef is a non-atomic check-then-set: it reads the ref, compares to baseRef, then SetReference with no lock. Two writers with separate go-git handles both pass the CAS check inside the TOCTOU window; the second SetReference clobbers the first commit, ErrRefMoved is never raised, and commitWithRetry never retries — the first record is silently dropped. This is pre-existing infra debt affecting ALL concurrent beadwork-branch commits (comments, closes, attachments), not just signals. internal/treefs/** is Out of Scope for vd6.1, so the fix cannot land there; vd6.1's bw.signal.store.concurrent_parity requirement is unsatisfiable until this closes.

Deliverable:
Make the check-and-set in casUpdateRef atomic for same-process concurrent writers: e.g. a process-wide per-common-gitdir mutex serializing casUpdateRef's read-compare-set critical section, or an equivalent atomicity mechanism inside internal/treefs. ErrRefMoved must be reliably raised whenever the ref moved since baseRef, so commitWithRetry retries and no commit is ever silently dropped. Cross-PROCESS atomicity is a known pre-existing limitation and stays out of scope — document it in a code comment if touched.

Verification:
- New test in internal/treefs reproducing the race: N goroutines (N>=4) commit concurrently through separate TreeFS handles against the same ref; every commit must survive (loser paths must see ErrRefMoved). Run with -race and -count=30 (the old code lost ~10% of runs — a single green is not proof).
- Cross-check (test file NOT in scope to edit; running it is fine): GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=commit.gpgsign GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=false go test ./internal/issue/ -run TestSignalConcurrentEmits -count=50 — must be green. Note: this test only exists on branch beadwork-vd6.1/signal-store (worktree /Users/mz/src/beadwork-signal-store); from your own worktree run it as: git -C <your-worktree> fetch is unnecessary — instead run the treefs-level test locally and the orchestrator will confirm the cross-check after merge.
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: targeted go test ./internal/treefs/... only.
  - Final tier: immediately before IMPLEMENTED, run make preflight, run-until-green.

Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- internal/treefs/**

Out of Scope (files):
- internal/issue/**, internal/signal/**, internal/intent/**, cmd/bw/**, test/**, .spec/**, docs/**

Out of Scope (intent):
- No TreeFS API-shape changes beyond what atomicity requires; single-writer behavior unchanged.
- No new external Go dependencies.
- No cross-process locking (flock etc.) — same-process atomicity only.

Merge gate:
- [ ] Code compiles cleanly
- [ ] New treefs race test passes with -race -count=30
- [ ] make preflight green
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only internal/treefs/**
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
